V0158_01_00_00_0.text:
I get to Duel you?
This is gonna be great!

V0158_01_00_01_0.text: I'll show you the power of my HERO Deck!

V0158_01_00_02_0.text:
Jaden, you'll never have to Duel alone.
Because you have me.

V0158_01_00_03_1.text:
You kidding me?
I'm more fired up than ever!

V0158_01_00_04_0.text:
I haven't Dueled like this in forever!
It's gonna be sweet!

V0158_01_00_05_0.text:
He can detect my presence.
I see why he's the King of Games.

V0158_01_00_06_0.text: The King of Games has a second soul inside of him!

V0158_01_00_07_0.text:
We have something in common.
The spirits like you too!

V0158_01_00_08_0.text: I sense incredible energies emanating from his Deck.

V0158_01_00_08_1.text: That means he's a Duelist worth defeating!

V0158_03_00_00_1.text:
You don't need to tell me twice!
It's my turn!

V0158_03_00_01_1.text:
Yup! Just gotta keep fighting to the finish!
It's my turn!

V0158_03_00_02_0.text: I always give it my all!

V0158_03_00_04_0.text: Jaden, despite all your foolish moves, you haven't lost yet.

V0158_03_00_04_1.text:
You really need to work on your pep talk.
It's my turn!

V0158_03_00_05_0.text:
Your moves are awesome!
They're giving me goosebumps!

V0158_03_00_05_1.text: This isn't the time to be impressed with your opponent!

V0158_05_00_00_1.text:
I got this, Yubel!
I drawww!

V0158_07_09_00_0.text: I flip over my Set card!

V0158_11_01_00_0.text: I Summon a monster in Defense Position!

V0158_21_00_01_0.text: The tide is turning our way.

V0158_21_00_04_0.text:
Believe in yourself.
There is no Duelist you cannot defeat.

V0158_21_00_04_1.text:
Yeah! I know!
I end my turn!

V0158_21_00_05_0.text:
That ends my turn!
But I'm gonna get my payback!

V0158_28_00_00_0.text: I have a special connection with the spirit world.

V0158_28_00_00_1.text: If I can use that ability to help people, I'm gonna do it.

V0158_28_00_01_0.text: That's what my Elemental HERO Deck can do!

V0158_28_00_02_0.text: When things get rough, just remember that Dueling is fun!

V0158_28_00_02_1.text:
That's game!
Thanks for a sweet Duel!

V0158_28_00_03_0.text:
I'll keep running straight ahead!
Towards the future!

V0158_28_00_04_0.text:
You've become stronger, Jaden.
Thanks to me.

V0158_28_00_04_1.text: Patting yourself on the back again?

V0158_28_00_06_0.text:
We'll see each other again.
No matter how far apart we are!

V0158_28_00_07_0.text: We choose our own fate - not you!

V0158_29_00_00_0.text: Win or lose, a sweet Duel is a sweet Duel!

V0158_29_00_01_0.text:
How can I not be stoked!
I got to Duel a champ like you!

V0158_29_00_02_0.text: You let your guard down, Jaden.

V0158_29_00_02_1.text:
No I didn't.
This Duelist was just super tough!

V0158_29_00_03_0.text: This is what happens when you forget that I can help you.

V0158_29_00_04_0.text:
You're incredible!
Nothing I do could break your spirit!

V0158_29_00_05_0.text: I've never met anyone as tough as you, Yugi!

V0158_29_00_06_0.text:
I don't know much about Synchro Summoning...
But I like it!

V0158_33_00_00_0.text: My Elemental HEROES can do anything and everything!

V0158_33_00_01_1.text:
Yes.
Let us battle as one, Jaden.

V0158_33_00_03_0.text:
Jaden, you are not alone.
You have me.

V0158_30_00_00_0.text: That's a crazy story! But I believe you!

V0158_30_00_01_0.text: I didn't know I was so popular!

V0158_30_00_02_0.text: Is that a Duel Disk from the future? It's super sweet!

V0158_34_00_00_0.text: After everything you put me through, I'm not backing down!

V0158_34_00_02_0.text: You don't do that to my friends!

V0158_34_00_04_0.text: You're not giving up already, are ya?

V0158_34_00_05_0.text: For a self-proclaimed conqueror, you make mediocre moves.

V0158_34_00_06_0.text: I can tell you're trying to regain what you've lost.

V0158_34_00_08_0.text:
It's Dark Magician!
The real thing!

V0158_34_00_08_1.text: Now isn't the time to be a fanboy!

V0158_34_00_09_0.text: Are you afraid? Your hands are shaking.

V0158_35_00_00_0.text:
The name's Jaden Yuki!
Get your game on!

V0158_35_00_01_0.text:
Jaden.
Don't pop up like a ghost, Yubel. You'll scare everyone.
No one is scared to see me anymore.

V0158_36_00_00_0.text: It's about time we end this!

V0158_36_00_02_0.text:
Haha!
It's so awesome that I get to Duel you!

V0158_36_00_04_0.text: I can't leave the field empty for Yugi!

V0158_36_00_07_0.text: This is all on you, Yusei!

V0158_36_00_08_0.text: We've come too far to give up, Yusei.
